title: Implement explicit bounded loops in YAML graphs
objective: Deliver release 0.3.0 with explicit bounded loops, compiler-enforced termination budgets, deterministic loop execution, and loop inspection.

branch.name: wi-0003-phase-three-loops
branch.rationale: The branch isolates WI-0003 implementation and release work.

request.text: Create WI-0003 for langgraph-exec: Deliver release 0.3.0 with explicit bounded loops, compiler-enforced termination budgets, deterministic loop execution, and loop inspection.

scope.name: loop-contract
scope.description: Define explicit loop declarations with entry, body, exit, condition, iteration state, and finite limits.
scope.reason: Loops need a safer contract than arbitrary graph back edges.

scope.name: loop-validation
scope.description: Reject undeclared cycles, missing exits, absent finite bounds, and routes that bypass loop budgets.
scope.reason: Unbounded execution is not acceptable in declarative workflows.

scope.name: loop-backend
scope.description: Lower validated loops into bounded LangGraph conditional transitions with graph-owned counters and step budgets.
scope.reason: The backend must enforce graph limits independently of backend defaults.

scope.name: loop-tests
scope.description: Add deterministic tests for early exit, exhaustion, nested bounds, failures, and observability.
scope.reason: Loop semantics require a dedicated evidence matrix.

scope.name: phase-three-release
scope.description: Repeat typecheck, tests, build, user-local link, and CLI loop inspection for v0.3.0.
scope.reason: Loops are a releasable capability, not an implicit graph change.

nonGoals.name: arbitrary-cycles
nonGoals.description: Do not permit cycles that are not declared as bounded loops.
nonGoals.reason: Every cycle must have an explicit safety contract.

nonGoals.name: durability
nonGoals.description: Do not make checkpoint/resume, interrupts, or external side-effect recovery part of the loop release.
nonGoals.reason: Those require a later persistence phase.

nonGoals.name: compatibility
nonGoals.description: Do not require phase-two graph/node definitions to remain unchanged if loop-capable graph schemas need an explicit version migration.
nonGoals.reason: Compatibility is a deliberate migration decision, not an assumption.

nonGoals.name: live-providers
nonGoals.description: Do not require live LLM/provider calls for loop unit-test evidence.
nonGoals.reason: Fake services and deterministic graph fixtures are sufficient for this phase gate.

items.name: loop-definition
items.description: A graph can declare a finite loop with entry, body, exit, condition, counter, and maximum iterations.
items.reason: Loop behavior must be explicit and inspectable.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Valid loop definitions expose effective bounds and invalid definitions fail before compilation.

items.name: loop-safety
items.description: The compiler rejects undeclared cycles and any loop without a finite termination budget.
items.reason: Declarative execution must fail closed against unbounded work.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Cycle, missing-exit, missing-limit, and bypass-route tests pass.

items.name: loop-execution
items.description: The LangGraph backend executes bounded iterations, exits early when conditions pass, and returns a structured limit failure on exhaustion.
items.reason: The runtime must distinguish successful termination from budget exhaustion.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Iteration counts and terminal status are deterministic under fake nodes.

items.name: loop-composition
items.description: Phase-two nodes and nested graphs can be used inside a bounded loop subject to the loop contract.
items.reason: Loops should extend composition rather than create a parallel model.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Nested loop-body composition and failure routing are tested.

items.name: phase-three-tests-link
items.description: The phase has its own loop unit tests and passes the full build/link/CLI release gate.
items.reason: Each phase must be independently releasable.

acceptanceCriteria.description: All prior regression tests plus phase-three tests pass before v0.3.0 delivery.
